title: stipagrostis lutescens
intro: Stipagrostis lutescens, commonly known as Pappus grass or Yellow Stipa, is a type of grass species native to southern Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in relieving cough, cold, and sore throat. The bioactive constituents of Stipagrostis lutescens include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
